query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_plants,
  SUM(CASE WHEN latinName IS NOT NULL AND latinName != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_latin_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN gbifId IS NULL AND latinName IS NOT NULL AND latinName != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as without_gbif,
  SUM(CASE WHEN family IS NULL AND latinName IS NOT NULL AND latinName != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as without_family
FROM plants;
